description: This file contains the PushRegistrationManager actor class responsible for handling push notification registration logic, including creating payloads for direct and relay transport modes, managing relay registration state, and performing cryptographic operations. It also defines related data structures for registration payloads and identities.

classes.name: PushRelayGatewayIdentity
classes.description: A data structure representing the identity of a relay gateway, including device ID and public key.

methods.name: makeGatewayRegistrationPayload
methods.description: Generates a registration payload for push notifications, handling direct and relay modes based on the build configuration.

methods.name: makeRelayPayload
methods.description: Creates a relay-specific registration payload, performing validation, state checks, and network registration as needed.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if a relay handle has expired based on its expiry timestamp.

methods.name: sha256Hex
methods.description: Computes the SHA256 hash of a string and returns it as a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: normalizeTokenSuffix
methods.description: Normalizes and trims an optional token suffix string.

methods.name: encodePayload
methods.description: Encodes an Encodable payload object into a JSON string.
